purpose: Freeze the executable reverse-flow topology and its claim boundary before any external calibration.

compressor_train.activation: explicit check-valve-failure at compressor.*, unloading.*, trailer.*, or global check-valve
compressor_train.source: highest-pressure cascade bank while the compressor is stopped
compressor_train.model_boundary: one quasi-steady signed path; no independent intermediate stage line-pack

vent_boundary.activation: explicit check-valve-failure at vent* or global check-valve
vent_boundary.sign_convention: release positive; ambient total-gas ingress negative

checks: bank mass loss equals trailer mass gain
target HAZOP rule activation after persistence
vent ambient ingress does not create hydrogen inventory

claim_boundary.allowed: The reverse-flow scenarios are executable and software-level conservation and alarm routing are tested.
claim_boundary.prohibited: Do not claim that the equivalent fault areas, reverse-flow magnitudes, compressor valve leakage, vent geometry, or field protection performance are externally validated.
